name: qfd_io_collective_s1-s1-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen TP8 compute-die STATIC collective cluster qfd_io_collective_static (OWNER 0ah: compiler command per message, fixed-offset rings, no credits/ready/queues; LU 37 / LS 376 = composed on the real static link RTL + R_max 7). 8 CLOSED ot_coll_fold_slice children (coll_fold_slice_rt) on own clock entries, 9 SRAM macros, glue on clk.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_io_collective_static u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/ot_qfd_io_collective_static.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_tp8_static.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_rst_leaf.sv rtl/rom/ot_coll_fold_slice.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x546_m1/ot_sram_1r1w_32x546_m1_bb.v physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_collective_s1/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_collective_s1/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_io_collective_s1 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_io_collective_static --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x546_m1 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/coll_fold_slice_rt/views/ot_coll_fold_slice > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
